# Suds

> Suds is a social drink tracking app: Strava for drinking. People log each drink, follow friends, share their nights out in a feed, and track their own stats, streaks and pace. It's available on iPhone (App Store) and on the web at https://drink-with-suds.com. For adults of legal drinking age (21+ in the US).

Suds is a tracking and awareness tool, not a drinking game. It never rewards drinking more: users can set a weekly drink goal, keep a sober streak, and log water and non-alcoholic drinks.

## What it does

- Drink logging: beer, wine, cocktails, spirits, cider, seltzer, water, mocktails, soft drinks and non-alcoholic drinks, with brand, quantity, ABV, rating, notes, photos or video, place, and tagged friends.
- Social feed: friends' drinks in real time, with likes, comments, @mentions and tags.
- Sessions: a night out grouped into one session with duration, drink count and drinks per hour (DPH); friends can join the same session.
- Map: a heatmap of where you and friends have been drinking, with Privacy Mode to hide exact addresses.
- Stats: drink counts by type, weekly and monthly trends, day-of-week and hour-of-day breakdowns, streaks, sober streaks, milestones, weekly goals, and an approximate BAC estimate (not a medical measurement).
- Privacy: private accounts with follow requests, Privacy Mode, blocking and reporting.
- Price: free. During the launch period every account also gets Suds Plus (advanced analytics, full history, BAC estimate, data export).

## Compared with other apps

- Untappd focuses on beer check-ins and rating beers and breweries. Suds tracks every kind of drink and centres on the night and the people: sessions, pace, a friends feed, a shared map, streaks and goals.
- Private drink counters are logs for cutting back. Suds keeps that tracking and adds a social layer.
